dimrender.screen.title: Dimension Render Distance
dimrender.screen.enabled.tooltip: Switch the render and simulation distance automatically when you change dimension.
dimrender.screen.notify.tooltip: Show a short message above the hotbar when a distance is switched.
dimrender.screen.remember.tooltip: When you change the render or simulation distance in Video Settings, it is saved for the dimension you are in.
dimrender.screen.render.tooltip:
How far chunks are drawn.

Far left: don't change it in this dimension. Otherwise %s–%s chunks.
dimrender.screen.simulation.tooltip:
How far the world keeps running: mobs move, crops grow, farms work.

Far left: don't change it in this dimension. Otherwise %s–%s chunks.

Only used in singleplayer and when you host a LAN world. On a server, the server decides.
dimrender.screen.forget: Remove from the list (it comes back when you visit it again)
dimrender.screen.reset_all.title: Reset all dimension settings?
dimrender.screen.reset_all.message: Every saved render and simulation distance is removed and the options go back to their defaults. Dimensions from servers and mods are removed from the list.
dimrender.info.not_in_world: Join a world to see the current dimension.
dimrender.info.server_limit: The server only sends %s chunks, more has no effect here.
dimrender.info.server_simulation: On a server, the server decides the simulation distance (here: %s chunks).
